identity.name: Nowon Lee
identity.lead: I trace service issues to their causes, improve data flow and asynchronous state, and verify behavior after deployment.
identity.supporting: I have solved problems involving real-time data, long-running tasks, operational dashboards, and service quality in TypeScript and React web services.

companies.summary: I worked on real-time data processing, long-running asynchronous tasks, operational dashboards, and quality assurance for public-sector web service projects.

contributions.title: Correcting operational metrics and query intervals
paragraphs: I analyzed missing values, incorrect usage ratios, and gaps in time-series data on a resource-monitoring dashboard, then handled the query and transformation changes through verification and deployment. I aligned metric names and labels with their definitions and actual responses, corrected the usage-ratio calculation, and separated time series that had been combined under the same label.

Instead of requesting the full time range for every update, I changed the query to request only data after the previous request time. Data transferred per 10-minute interval fell from 96.5 MB to 41 KB. I compared the updated dashboard with actual responses to verify that the corrected metrics were displayed properly.

contributions.title: Status checks and waiting guidance for long-running document generation
paragraphs: For document generation that takes 5–10 minutes, I translated the requirements into screens and interactions and handled implementation and deployment. The interface shows progress and elapsed time, explains the consequences of navigating away or cancelling, and continues checking status when the user chooses not to cancel.

When SSE reports the start or completion of a step, the client requests the server status again and updates the UI from that response. If another event arrives during a request, the client finishes the current request before checking again. It also checks server status after a connection error. An event alone never determines success or failure.

Recorded status API requests remain at 10 or fewer per task. This is compared with an estimated 100–200 requests for polling the same task every three seconds; it does not mean document generation became faster. After deployment, I verified that generation, cancellation, and the displayed progress matched the actual processing state.

contributions.title: Separating response processing and merging real-time data
paragraphs: I resolved 3–4 second UI freezes that occurred while requesting and transforming API responses of about 5 MB. Instead of changing the response size or format, I moved the API request and transformation into a SharedWorker and left the main thread to update the UI with the transformed data.
I prepared a reusable request method for the run-history and detail screens that needed the same processing, then verified after deployment that the UI freeze was resolved.

For a real-time chart, I merged REST history loaded after refresh and streamed values into the same cache queue and normalized their time units. Incomplete JSON fragments are retained and combined with the next chunk before processing.

contributions.title: E2E coverage of real user flows and authentication recovery
paragraphs: I created more than 70 executable E2E scenarios to repeat the actual flows of authenticated users. During this work, I reproduced a mismatch between credentials retained in the browser and an expired server session.

I applied the same recovery rule to authentication checks before protected screens and to authentication failures while a screen was in use. I handled root-cause analysis, the shared recovery design and implementation, and deployment to the QA environment.

companies.summary: I traced errors and performance regressions in React and TypeScript services and improved data updates, loading performance, and real-time connections.

contributions.title: Keeping refreshed data and UI state consistent
paragraphs: I applied optimistic updates in an environment that periodically refetched data. This resolved discrepancies between the UI after a user action and the server value while reducing duplicate requests.

contributions.title: Improving loading and documenting the setup
paragraphs: I improved service loading performance with Vite configuration and React lazy loading. I documented the steps so the same approach could be applied to other frontend projects.

contributions.title: Finding the cause of interrupted real-time connections
paragraphs: Intermittent WebSocket disconnections prevented real-time data from updating. I used Chrome DevTools to identify the cause of the disconnections and resolved the data-update problem.

contributions.verification: Added regression coverage while preserving existing dot-suffix behavior.
